title: 第十九章 汲血阵第二十章 全城
content_zh:
“老师，这个严烜到底是什么来历？”楚元问道；
他现在操心的再多也没用，天塌下来有高个子顶着现在不就是齐达在顶着么？
“严烜啊”黄波脸上露出一丝复杂、有痛心、有愤怒，也有可惜。
“你们应该知道一些事情，其实他是你们的学长来着只不过那是十年前的事情了。”
“十年前？也就是说，严烜现在才二十**？
怎么看着跟四五十似的？”
“当年出了一些事情，他的武道根基被废了，身体亏空，所以看上去比较老。”黄波解释了一下，又接着说道“当初我刚来一中任教，就听说了严烜的名字；
他是一个武道天才！
从领取淬元功修炼，到进入气血境，只用了一个星期的时间；
后来在高考前夕，更是达到了不漏境中段的修为！在高考中大放异彩！
夺得了晨阳市第一，玉南府第三的成绩，被四大武校之一的神都武校录取”
许多人的目光不自觉的看向楚元，武道天才楚元不也是一个武道天才么？
或许他和当时的严烜一样，现在已经进入气血境了吧？
有人直接问道“楚元，你是不是已经气血境了？”
楚元点了点头“嗯。”
杨易自然是知道楚元不是什么气血境的，连忙岔开话题“那后来呢？后来他怎么被废了？”
黄波摇了摇头“那我知道的就不是很清楚了只是听说去天外前线战场历练，执行学校任务的过程中出了一些意外；
然后就
当时我们一中的校长还不是齐校长，而是陈校长。
陈校长听说了这个消息之后，亲自去神都把他接了过来，安置在学校内。

没想到”
“老师，我听说是因为他得到了一份强者的传承，导致被人盯上，下了黑手？”
黄波含含糊糊道“可能吧，毕竟天外战场虽然机缘多，但什么意外也都有可能发生；
你们以后去了天外战场也要注意”
说是如此，但黄波其实心里知道，大多数人去天外战场；
只是以军队普通士兵的身份去的，并没有太多自主行动的权限当然也不会遇到和当初严烜类似的事情。
甚至会有相当一部分学生，连去都去不成；
只能留在大秦，加入治安局、或者城市守卫军这种低级作战序列。
也称之为养老单位。
虽然没什么危险，但也没什么机缘；
往往入职的时候是什么修为，好几年甚至十几年之后，还是一样的修为。
就比如他自己
在说话的空档，一声蕴满能量的怒喝再次响起，是齐达在怒吼，语气中隐约有一丝惊惶；
“严烜！住手！！你真的要找死！？”
教室内的玻璃都被这一声暴喝震碎，许多人更是像喝醉了一样，摇摇晃晃的跌倒在地；
然而这对同为神通境的严烜自然是没什么杀伤的。
他脸上的麻木终于慢慢褪去，转化成了兴奋和狂热；
“哈哈哈哈哈哈~齐校长，我还是更喜欢你刚才那副运筹帷幄的样子”
content_en:
"Teacher, what is the origin of this Yan Xuan?" Chu Yuan asked;
It's useless no matter how much he worries now. If the sky falls, a tall man will hold it up, isn't it Zida who will hold it up now?
"Yan Xuan," Huang Bo's face showed a hint of complexity, pain, anger, and pity.
"You should know something. In fact, he is your senior, but that was ten years ago."
"Ten years ago? In other words, Yan Xuan is only 20 years old now?
Why do you look like you're in your forties? "
"Something happened back then. His martial arts foundation was ruined and his body was exhausted, so he looked older." Huang Bo explained, and then continued, "When I first came to teach in No. 1 Middle School, I heard Yan Xuan's name;
He is a martial arts genius!
It only took a week from receiving the Yuanyuan Gong practice to entering the Qi and Blood Realm;
Later, on the eve of the college entrance examination, he even reached the middle stage of his cultivation! Shine in the college entrance examination!
Won the first place in Chenyang City and the third place in Yunan Prefecture, and was admitted to Shendu Martial Arts School, one of the four major martial arts schools."
Many people looked at Chu Yuan unconsciously. Isn't the martial arts genius Chu Yuan also a martial arts genius?
Maybe he, like Yan Xuan at that time, has now entered the Qi and Blood realm?
Someone asked directly, "Chu Yuan, are you already in the Qi and Blood realm?"
Chu Yuan nodded, "Yes."
Yang Yi naturally knew that Chu Yuan was not in the Qi and Blood realm, so he quickly changed the subject, "What happened next? Why was he abolished later?"
Huang Bo shook his head, "Then I don't know very clearly. I just heard that I went to Tianwai frontline battlefield for training, and some accidents occurred while performing school tasks;
Then just
At that time, the principal of our No. 1 Middle School was not Principal Qi, but Principal Chen.
After Principal Chen heard the news, he personally went to Shendu to pick him up and placed him in the school.
Didn’t expect that”
"Teacher, I heard that it was because he received the inheritance of a strong man that he was targeted and plotted?"
Huang Bo said vaguely, "Maybe, after all, although there are many opportunities in the outer battlefield, any accident can happen;
You should also pay attention when you go to the outer battlefield in the future."
Although he said so, Huang Bo actually knew in his heart that most people went to the outer battlefield;
He only went there as an ordinary soldier in the army, and did not have much authority to act independently. Of course, he would not encounter anything similar to Yan Xuan.
There will even be a considerable number of students who cannot even go;
They can only stay in Da Qin and join low-level combat orders such as the Public Security Bureau or the City Guard Army.
Also called a retirement home.
Although there is no danger, there is no chance;
Often, no matter what level of cultivation you have when you join the company, you will still have the same level of cultivation after several years or even more than ten years.
Just like himself
While speaking, an energetic roar sounded again. It was Qida roaring, with a hint of panic in his tone;
"Yan Xuan! Stop!! Are you really looking for death!?"
The glass in the classroom was shattered by the loud shout, and many people staggered to the ground as if they were drunk;
However, this naturally did no harm to Yan Xuan, who was also in the magical power realm.
The numbness on his face finally slowly faded away, turning into excitement and enthusiasm;
"Hahahahaha~ Principal Qi, I still prefer the way you were strategizing just now."
